info.title: AutoLog KE API
info.description: API documentation for the AutoLog KE platform

bearerAuth.description: Enter JWT token in the format: Bearer <token>

post.summary: Join the AutoLog Kenya early access / beta tester waitlist
post.description: Captures early tester lead with mandatory phone consent (Item

phone.description: Valid Kenyan mobile number normalized to +254...

phoneConsent.description: Explicit consent to receive early access updates via SMS/WhatsApp

400.description: Validation error or missing phone consent

get.summary: Get public waitlist count for social proof
Public Digital Vehicle Passport (Sanitized, Masked & Trust-Scored)
get.description: Allows prospective car buyers, insurers, and inspectors to verify vehicle history without an account. Plate and chassis are masked for privacy.

404.description: Vehicle passport not found or is private

get.summary: Public Digital Vehicle Handover Certificate (Masked Privacy)
get.description: Generates a tamper-evident digital vehicle passport handover certificate with verified odometer integrity, 3-tier trust metrics, predictive health status, and cryptographic SHA-256 verification hash. Plate and chassis are masked for public privacy.

get.summary: Print-Ready Public Vehicle Handover Certificate (HTML)
get.description: Renders a printable, security-styled HTML certificate for browser print and PDF export with masked plate and chassis for public buyers.

post.description: Public anti-tamper authenticity check for car buyers, commercial banks, and SACCO loan officers. Evaluates SHA-256 seal against live database records to distinguish between VALID_AUTHENTIC, OUTDATED_SUPERSEDED, and TAMPERED_INVALID certificates.

get.summary: Resolve vehicle details for mobile check-in screen using magic token
get.description: Public endpoint called by the mobile check-in screen. Validates the 72h token and displays vehicle make, model, plate, and previous recorded mileage.

post.summary: Submit new odometer reading via magic token
post.description: Updates vehicle odometer reading. Enforces anti-rollback defense and automatically recalibrates daily driving burn rate if >= 1 day has elapsed.

newMileage.description: New odometer reading in KM (must be >= current mileage)

200.description: Odometer reading updated and burn rate recalibrated successfully

400.description: Odometer rollback detected (new mileage lower than current)

post.summary: Trigger check-in prompts batch for stale vehicles
post.description: Scans for active vehicles not updated in >= 7 days and generates fresh 72h check-in magic links.

post.summary: Register a new vehicle to the digital passport

plateNumber.description: Valid Kenyan NTSA plate (K + 2 letters + space + 3 digits + 1 letter)

400.description: Validation error or current mileage lower than initial mileage

409.description: Vehicle with this plate number is already registered

get.summary: List all vehicles owned by the authenticated user

200.description: List of user's vehicles retrieved successfully

get.summary: Get single vehicle by ID (Owner Isolation Guard)

404.description: Vehicle not found or belongs to another user

get.summary: Predictive Maintenance & Service Due Schedules
get.description: Computes upcoming service intervals, remaining mileage, estimated due dates, and urgent maintenance alerts based on verified odometer readings and logged service history.

404.description: Vehicle not found or not owned by user

get.summary: Generate Official Digital Vehicle Handover Certificate
get.description: Produces an official tamper-proof digital handover certificate with unmasked NTSA plate, chassis number, verified odometer progression, trust score breakdown, and predictive health badge for sale handover, SACCO compliance, and bank financing.

200.description: Official vehicle handover certificate generated successfully

404.description: Vehicle not found or not owned by user

get.summary: Print-Ready Official Vehicle Handover Certificate (HTML)
get.description: Renders an official, printable security-styled HTML handover certificate with unmasked plate and chassis number for bank financing, SACCO registration, and vehicle ownership transfer.

404.description: Vehicle not found or not owned by user

post.summary: Transfer Vehicle Ownership to Another Motorist
post.description: Transfers vehicle passport ownership to a newly registered buyer identified by Kenyan phone (+254...) or email, archiving a final Handover Certificate and logging transfer history.

400.description: Cannot transfer to self or validation error

get.summary: Vehicle Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) & Spend Analytics
get.description: Returns aggregated maintenance spend, cost per kilometer, monthly average expenses, and category breakdown via MongoDB aggregation pipeline.

404.description: Vehicle not found or not owned by user

400.description: Rollback detected (new mileage is lower than current mileage)

post.summary: Generate signed 72-hour magic check-in link for a vehicle
post.description: Creates a tamper-evident, time-limited magic link for the car owner to check in their odometer reading without logging in.

404.description: Vehicle not found or not owned by user

post.summary: Log a new vehicle service record
post.description: Stamped by vehicle owner or verified partner garage. Tier 1 (Self) if no receipt, Tier 2 (Documented) if receipt attached, Tier 3 (Partner) if stamped by verified partner garage.

serviceDate.description: Date service was performed (cannot be future date)

description.example: Replaced engine oil with 5W-30 synthetic and installed new front ceramic brake pads

403.description: Forbidden (Not vehicle owner or authorized garage)

get.summary: Get complete service history for a vehicle
Get single service record details

patch.summary: Attach receipt proof to a service record and upgrade verification tier
patch.description: Allows the vehicle owner or logger to attach a receipt photo, upgrading the record from Tier 1 (Self) to Tier 2 (Documented).

200.description: Receipt attached and tier upgraded successfully

403.description: Forbidden (not vehicle owner, logger, or admin)

post.summary: Create a new spare parts RFQ
post.description: Car owners and garages can broadcast requests for genuine, OEM, or aftermarket parts. Automatically extracts vehicle fitment specs.

description.example: Needs to fit 2019 Toyota Land Cruiser Prado J150 1GD-FTV

get.summary: List all RFQs created by the logged-in user

200.description: List of user RFQs retrieved successfully

get.summary: Dealer Feed - Browse open RFQs needing quotes
get.description: Exclusively accessible to registered parts dealers and platform admins. Displays complete fitment specs (engine code, chassis, year) to eliminate incorrect part delivery.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Filter by part category (e.g. SUSPENSION, BRAKES)

get.summary: Get RFQ details by ID
get.description: Includes Anti-Cartel Blind-Bidding protection. Requesters see all competing bids sorted cheapest first. Dealers only see vehicle specs and their own submitted quote.

400.description: Cannot cancel fulfilled or accepted RFQ

post.summary: Submit quotation with 48-Hour Price Lock Guarantee
post.description: Authorized parts dealers submit price, brand, and warranty. Price is contractually locked for 48 hours to eliminate the 'bei ilipanda asubuhi' bait-and-switch.

notes.example: Includes mounting bushes and dust boot kit

201.description: Quote submitted successfully with 48-hour price lock

409.description: Active quote already submitted by this dealer

get.summary: Get all quotes submitted by logged-in dealer

patch.summary: Accept a quote (Atomically locks deal and rejects competing bids)
patch.description: Finalizes transaction with winning dealer and releases direct contact details for delivery/collection.

400.description: Expired 48h price lock or already closed quote

post.summary: Register a new user account (Owner, Dealer, or Garage)

businessDetails.description: Mandatory for 'dealer' or 'garage'. Must be omitted for 'owner'.

409.description: Email or phone number already registered

post.summary: Log in with Email OR Kenyan Phone Number

identifier.description: Email address OR Kenyan phone number

get.summary: Get current authenticated user profile
Platform health & ecosystem statistics
List and search users (Owners, Garages, Dealers)

patch.summary: Verify or revoke garage accreditation (Tier 3 Partner status)

400.description: Target user is not a garage

patch.summary: Suspend or reactivate user account (Instant session revocation)
